title: Child Bereavement UK
description: childbereavementuk.org Child Bereavement UK is a leading British charity founded in 1994 by Dr. Jenny Knight OBE, supporting families and educating professionals when a baby or child dies or is dying across the United Kingdom. With 80 to 120 staff and 200 to 300 volunteers, it serves over 5,000 families annually through individual counselling, group support, sibling programmes and a free helpline. It has trained over 20,000 professionals including NHS staff, teachers, social workers and emergency services in evidence-based bereavement care. Its services cover miscarriage, stillbirth, neonatal death, sudden infant death, childhood illness, suicide and parental bereavement. Revenue is approximately 5 to 8 million pounds from grants, donations, training income and fundraising events. The organization also conducts research and advocates for policy change in child bereavement care across England, Scotland and Wales.
